patch.value: GH-825: restore SDK excess-property safety for extension definition metadata
Open index signatures on FlagDefinition and schema definition interfaces allow plausible misspellings to type-check, then abort runtime activation and drop later registrations.

Known-field interfaces enforce excess-property checking; any metadata escape hatch is explicitly namespaced; type tests reject name/type misspellings; activation remains atomic and suggests canonical fields
Make invalid extension metadata fail at author time while preserving explicit forward-compatible metadata
Package authors receive a compiler error before activation can partially register commands
Closes a typed SDK/runtime contract gap across flags and schema definitions
